as_told.title: Puthoff: 10 to 40 craft and Bush disclosure talks

related.note: Both give a count of the crashed craft the US holds. Davis says fewer than 40, which differs from Puthoff's 15, so one count could be right and the other wrong.

plain: The physicist Hal Puthoff is said to have stated on Joe Rogan's podcast in 2025 that the US has "15 crash craft in our possession." Michels brings this up on his own show more than once, at one point giving it as 12 to 15 craft and asking where Puthoff got the figure, and at another as 10 to 40, adding that Puthoff says he worked with President George W. Bush and his national security adviser Stephen Hadley on whether to make disclosures. If true, the government would be holding many recovered craft of unknown origin.
